messages:
lucas_csm: Quick heads-up  we identified a replay backlog that impacted onboarding activations for ~16 tenants between 01:30-01:58 UTC on 2026-09-02. Flagging 2 high-touch customers as renewal-risk. Need: a short external status + RCA blurb, validation checklist, and office hours invite for later today.

jess_cs: Ack. Do we know if any Dedicated or Private deployments were impacted? That affects credit language. :thinking_face:

incident_bot: [incident created] INC-2026-0902-01 | sev=2 | owner=@marta_sre | tags=[onboard,replay,ingest-backlog]

marta_sre: Triage summary: an operator-submitted configuration change to the replay scheduler reduced its worker pool unexpectedly (human error + missing guard). That caused a transient replay slowdown and queueing; retries from clients amplified the backlog. Majority of affected tenants were on shared onboarding, but 2 Dedicated tenants with cross-shard writes saw slowed activations.

kyle_infra: Telemetry: replay_worker_count dropped from 12 -> 2 for ~18 minutes; ingest_replay_backlog peaked at 178 (baseline ~12). Change was reverted and guarded at 1840001320; replay ramped and is currently ~76% complete.

lucas_csm: Draft external message (short): ```Hello  we experienced delayed onboarding activations affecting a subset of accounts between 01:3001:58 UTC on 2026-09-02. What happened: a configuration change to our replay scheduler temporarily reduced replay capacity, which caused a backlog and delayed some activations. What we did: reverted the change, added a guard to prevent similar operator mistakes, and reprocessed the affected batches. Current status: reprocessing is ~76% complete; most customers are processing normally. Next steps: full replay expected within 4 hours; we will host office hours at 18:00 UTC today to review impact and answer questions (link). Compensation: Hosted customers who were impacted will receive a pro-rated onboarding credit. For Dedicated/Private customers we will coordinate remediation and credits on a case-by-case basis. Apologies for the disruption  Redwood Inference Team```

jess_cs: LGTM. Add a tiny validation checklist for customers to run and a curl snippet: (1) check index doc counts, (2) run a smoke query, (3) confirm last_indexed_at for a sample doc. Snippet: ```curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.example/v1/indexes/<index_id>/stats | jq .doc_count```

marta_sre: From SRE: change was human error (operator typo) + missing validation; fix = guard on scheduler size, automated preflight checks for future changes, and replay idempotency improvements. Patch and guard deployed at 1840001320. Postmortem ETA EOD 2026-09-02.

kyle_infra: Evidence note for CS: replay_worker_count and backlog histograms will be attached to the postmortem. We also captured the exact operator command that initiated the change.

lucas_csm: Jess  please send the external note to the affected list and CC me. I'll own outreach to the two renewal-risk customers and coordinate credits. Capture feedback during office hours and we'll add action items to the postmortem.

jess_cs: Sending now to affected tenants, office hours link included. I'll also post an internal-only follow-up with the impacted account list.

marta_sre: Monitoring replay progress; will alert CS if any tenant replay falls behind >6h.

kyle_infra: Adding scheduler config diff and a short log excerpt to the postmortem for CS reference.

lucas_csm: Thanks all  closing loop for CS prep.
